question: #13160 at 754b56ee against main: before playback, does the bar stay drawn while one marker popover, or a second one opened by a mouse click, is open, and hide normally once focus leaves, with no stuck hold? Is everything else unchanged?

method.story: lab-mediaplayer--comment-markers; its sample video loads (5.059 s), so the three markers draw
method.device: 1280x800, scale 1, real keyboard and mouse events (Playwright, through the DevTools protocol); light and dark
method.bar: the control bar is the player's [data-visible] element; its computed opacity, visibility, translate and pointer-events, data-visible, and whether it matches :focus-within
method.handoff: Tab to marker A, Enter; then the mouse moves to marker B in 4 steps and clicks; every frame from 200 ms before the click to 1600 ms after. Escape until no marker is open. Then the mouse clicks blank page above and left of the player (focus leaves); every frame for 3400 ms
method.prev: the previous head 70245c94 runs the handoff flow only, as a third build
method.escape: Escape is pressed until the marker popover closes
method.cut: focus names are cut at 50 characters; a cut name ends in an ellipsis in the index
method.samples: handoff samples: [ms since the click, opacity, data-visible, focus-within, each marker's aria-expanded, focus name, paused]
